faqs.q: What are the Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Couplings and what are they used for?
faqs.a: The Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Coupling is the female half of a ring lock coupling: a ring lock female end on one side and a hose shank on the other. It locks onto a male half with a lever-operated ring and seals on a gasket, for water and slurry lines that are moved often.

faqs.q: How do the part numbers for the Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Couplings read?
faqs.a: The maker's codes are RLC, the size in hundredths of an inch and F for female: RLC200F is 2", RLC300F is 3", RLC600F is 6" and RLC800F is 8". Compare with the male half, which ends in M.

faqs.q: What sizes do the Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Couplings come in?
faqs.a: The Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Couplings are listed in 2", 3", 6" and 8", in 4 part numbers such as IH-RL-HOSE-SHANK-FEMALE-200 and IH-RL-HOSE-SHANK-FEMALE-800.

faqs.q: Which size of ring lock female coupling do I need for my hose?
faqs.a: Choose the size that matches the hose bore on the shank end and the male half it must lock onto: 2", 3", 6" or 8". This female half starts at 2", the one size that the male half and the complete set do not list.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Couplings?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a working pressure for the Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Couplings. The hose, its clamps and the medium usually set the limit before the coupling does. Give us your working pressure and medium and we will check it with the manufacturer before you order.

faqs.q: What are the Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Couplings made from?
faqs.a: Zinc plating protects the steel in damp or wet service, which suits water and slurry lines, but it is not a stainless or chemical-resistant finish. The seal is a gasket, as on the maker's drawing.

faqs.q: Which standards do the Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Couplings follow?
faqs.a: The maker lists no dimensional or performance standard for the female half. Ring lock is a maker pattern that resembles Bauer without being the same, so confirm the mating half or ask for the drawing before you pair it with another make.

faqs.q: What does the Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Coupling lock onto?
faqs.a: It locks onto a ring lock male half of the same size, such as the [zinc plated steel hose shank male coupling](/p/zinc-plated-steel-hose-shank-male-couplings), closed with a lever ring. Ring lock looks like Bauer but is a different pattern, so confirm the mating half before you pair the two. The hose goes on the shank end.

faqs.q: How do I install and look after the Zinc Plated Steel Hose Shank Female Couplings?
faqs.a: Seat the gasket in the female end, bring the male half in and close the lever ring. Check the gasket at each make-up and replace a worn locking ring rather than forcing the lever. The [zinc plated steel lever rings](/p/zinc-plated-steel-lever-rings) are sold as spares.

faqs.q: How does the female hose shank coupling differ from the male coupling and the complete set?
faqs.a: The female half has the ring lock female end and is listed in 2", 3", 6" and 8". The [male coupling](/p/zinc-plated-steel-hose-shank-male-couplings) lists 3", 4", 6" and 8", and the [female x male complete set](/p/zinc-plated-steel-hose-shank-female-x-male-coupling-complete-set-with-ring-lock) starts at 3". Only the female half comes in 2".

faqs.q: What are the Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings and what are they used for?
faqs.a: The Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings are the spare locking rings for ring lock couplings: the lever-operated ring that closes a male half onto a female half. They are listed in 3", 4", 6" and 8". Fit one when the original ring is worn or the lever no longer locks.

faqs.q: How do the part numbers for the Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings read?
faqs.a: The maker's codes are RLC, the size digits and LR for lever ring: RLC300LR is 3", RLC400LR is 4", RLC600LR is 6" and RLC800LR is 8".

faqs.q: What sizes do the Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings come in?
faqs.a: The Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings are listed in 3", 4", 6" and 8", in 4 part numbers such as IH-RL-LEVER-RINGS-300 and IH-RL-LEVER-RINGS-800.

faqs.q: Which lever ring size matches my ring lock coupling?
faqs.a: Match the ring to the coupling size, which is the same nominal size as the hose bore on the shank: 3", 4", 6" or 8". The 2" female coupling does not have a lever ring listed here.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a working pressure for the Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings. The hose, its clamps and the medium usually set the limit before the coupling does. Give us your working pressure and medium and we will check it with the manufacturer before you order.

faqs.q: What are the Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings made from?
faqs.a: The lever rings are zinc-plated steel, the same finish as the ring lock halves they close. Zinc plating protects against corrosion in damp or wet service but is not a stainless or chemical-resistant finish.

faqs.q: Which standards do the Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings follow?
faqs.a: The maker lists no dimensional or performance standard for the lever rings. They fit the maker's ring lock halves, and ring lock resembles Bauer without being the same pattern, so confirm the fit before using one on another make.

faqs.q: Which ring lock couplings take the Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings?
faqs.a: The ring fits ring lock halves of the same nominal size, such as the [female](/p/zinc-plated-steel-hose-shank-female-couplings), [male](/p/zinc-plated-steel-hose-shank-male-couplings) and [complete set](/p/zinc-plated-steel-hose-shank-female-x-male-coupling-complete-set-with-ring-lock) in this range. Ring lock resembles Bauer but is not the same pattern, so confirm before using it on another make.

faqs.q: How do I install and look after the Zinc Plated Steel Lever Rings?
faqs.a: Replace a worn locking ring rather than forcing the lever, and check the gasket at the same time. A ring that will not close on a clean, seated gasket is worn and should be changed. The maker publishes no working pressure for the ring.

faqs.q: How do the lever rings differ from the ring lock couplings themselves?

The ring lists the same four sizes as the male half: 3", 4", 6" and 8".
